title: Reassess Japanese capability after documentation truth correction
rawUserRequest: Japanese capability is mandatory because most adopter-project engineers use Japanese. Before release, run a comprehensive Japanese assessment and correct every problem. Continue the approved serial plan without stopping when no confirmation is needed; after the documentation-truth corrective, perform a fresh independent final reassessment, preserve instruction-plan-implementation-acceptance traceability, complete PR and branch cleanup, and only then continue to documentation alignment and release.

declaredIntent.summary: Produce a fresh exact-source final Japanese capability assessment after the documentation-truth corrective, without overclaiming or advancing later release stages.

outOfScope: Claiming general provider/model Japanese fluency or native-human translation quality.
Repairing a newly discovered Japanese capability blocker inside this final assessment; every blocker requires a separate corrective Work Item.
Resuming documentation alignment, deleting deprecated assets or implemented plans, publishing a release, changing release metadata, creating a tag, or changing a GitHub Release.
Changing runtime identity, isolation, signing, branch protection, enterprise controls, or compliance claims.
Reusing japanese-final-reassessment-20260729 or pre-release-documentation-truth-corrective-20260729 as proof that this new post-corrective lifecycle completed.

acceptance: A1: The canonical JSON and Markdown identify japanese-final-reassessment-after-documentation-truth-20260729 with workItemRole final_reassessment and never present either historical reassessment or the documentation corrective as current proof.

A2: The complete 12-domain Japanese repository-governance matrix is regenerated from the synchronized post-corrective main, directly binds every declared stable evidence file by normalized path and SHA-256, and reports zero blockingFindings.

A3: Japanese input trust, injection, Unicode/encoding/path handling, Wizard/CLI, Cockpit Status, PR/Task Outcome, installation/calibration/upgrade/rollback/uninstall lifecycle, and multilingual documentation evidence are executable and passing.

A4: Checked-in JSON and derived Markdown are deterministic and mutually aligned; any bound-byte or asserted-source mismatch fails closed, while unrelated repository drift does not create a false stale result.

A5: README, Trust Layer, security/release, Documentation Architecture, Capability Truth, and other multilingual authority files added by the documentation corrective are included in the exact-source inventory and covered by representative byte-drift regressions.

A6: General provider/model Japanese fluency and native-human translation quality remain explicit limitations and are never promoted to passed capability claims; Capability Truth remains the only implementation-status authority.

A7: Every non-zero blocker is recorded with a stable finding ID and routed to a separate corrective Work Item before this reassessment can finish; a zero-blocker result is supported by direct machine evidence.

A8: The user instruction, comprehensive plan, new plan, Contract, implementation, report, tests, Summary, and acceptance evidence map bidirectionally without deleting or rewriting historical identities.

A9: Full local quality, ai-finish archive, aggregate PR verification, exact-Head Hosted checks, merge, ai-close-work-item, local/remote branch deletion, worktree cleanup, and synchronized clean main complete before documentation alignment resumes.

A10: This Work Item changes no Japanese product behavior beyond assessment identity/evidence regeneration, no capability truth status, no release metadata, no tag, no GitHub Release, and no later-stage completion state.
guidelines: Evidence over self-declaration: accept Japanese capability only from executable and exact-source repository evidence.
Bind corrected multilingual authority bytes directly; do not infer Japanese evidence from English files.
Keep general fluency, translation quality, and provider behavior outside the bounded claim.
Treat every blocker as a separate corrective lifecycle and keep later stages blocked until closure.
Keep Capability Truth as the only current implementation-status authority.
Preserve immutable historical archives and complete one Work Item, branch, and PR lifecycle.

intent.problem: The prior Japanese final reassessment completed before the five-strategy documentation review changed and expanded source-bound multilingual authority files. Main now truthfully carries a corrective_validation report, so release lacks an independent final_reassessment over the corrected exact source.

Keep documentation alignment, deprecated cleanup, release publication, and plan cleanup in later independent Work Items.
Complete PR, merge, closure, branch cleanup, and main synchronization before resuming documentation alignment.
